title: NKA Pecs U20 win National Championship
description: NKA Pecs U20 have won National Championship beating Budapesti Honved SE U20 81-71 in the decisive game. Salamon Herger (206-C-2001) and Gergely Schmera (196-F-2004) stepped up with 17 points each. Balint Scherer (196-F/G-2001) netted 12, whilst Oliver Vaits (180-G-2001) brought 10. Peter Redei (190-2002) replied with 16 points in the losing effort and Akos Kopacsi (182-PG-2001) produced 15. Budapesti Honved SE U20 finished second, whilst Falco-Volvo Alpok Auto Szombathely U20 clinched third place.
